The .history of what is known as the "Tanjore Palace Estarc'.'

Iyer('). In 1799, Serfoji, the then Raja of Tanjore, surrendered
his terri1ory into the hands of the East India Company, but he
was allowed to retain possession of certain vill~ges and lands
which constitu1ed his private property. When his son the lasl

Tanjore Raj in favour of the heirs of the late Raja". Under
